label: Noir
context_hint: Classic film-noir mood — stark black-and-white or heavily desaturated tones, venetian-blind shadows, cigarette smoke, rain-slicked streets, harsh single-source lighting. Compositions are moody and theatrical, often shot from a low or oblique angle. Characters are morally ambiguous, framed in silhouette or half-shadow. Tone is cynical, atmospheric, and restrained rather than loud.
